before_execution: Cargo --frozen --offline plus pinned source-replacement config and no credential/network fallback
Collect exact selected native target graph and enabled build features; reject new/unreviewed package/script/features
Prove gettext-sys/gettext-system and exact LinuxGNU target before compilation; missing proof blocks bundled fallback
Reject system-deps binary/archive features, ensure system-deps-meta absent; no inference from default declaration alone
Confirm Windows import libraries/wasm scripts/defmt optional features actual selection or revise scope explicitly
Pin actual glib/gio .pc versions from features and native builder; record compiler/LLVM parse/cfgs and detect assumed-latest fallbacks
environment: Clear inherited SYSTEM_DEPS_*, PKG_CONFIG_*, GETTEXT_*, compiler/linker/archiver target env variants, LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH and Cargo config/target/rustflags overrides; apply explicit worker allowlist afterwards
Fix/record HOME/TMPDIR/CARGO_HOME/CARGO_TARGET_DIR, locale/time/SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH; Cargo sets OUT_DIR/feature/CARGO_CFG facts
No target-cpu=native, Apple ISA tuning, unsafe atomic/experimental rustix cfg or --all-features
isolation: Disposable unprivileged nativeARM worker, no network/caps, no-new-privileges; root/toolchain/vendor source read-only

Only dedicated no-credential CARGO_HOME, CARGO_TARGET_DIR/OUT_DIR, private TMPDIR and staging DESTDIR writable; packaging may copy app source to disposable build scratch, never mutate pinned originals
No host writable/device/display/D-Bus/audio/SSH/signing sockets, no nested writable mounts below source/toolchain roots
CPU/memory/pid/disk budgets, total deadline and whole-container/processgroup cleanup; bounded logs and artifacts
later_evidence: Two independent clean native build logs, artifact SHA/bytecomparison and ELF ARM/ABI/pagealignment checks
Mock D-Bus/update/reboot functionality and actual Apple lifecycle checks remain separate from build approval
tools: Separately pinned native rustc/Cargo>=1.92 plus linker/compiler, glib2 native .pc inputs, pkgconf and packaging tools
RUSTC fixed absolute pinned worker binary; controlled PATH, no rustup shims or wrappers
No emcc/freebsd-version in PATH; expected libc emcc spawn returns absent
Native PKG_CONFIG/.pc locations pinned; no host sysroot/cross overrides
